notes.title: Drift Zone 1.1 patch + discount
notes.content:
Hello Drifters,

To celebrate the release of our game on [b]Xbox One[/b], we cut the price by half and made patch that contains various bug fixes and tweaks in game mechanics.

Changes:
- Reworked earning system (you will get cash reward depending from scored points)
- Cash rewards for ghost multiplayer races
- Added missing colors for rollcage
- Added more maps to Freestyle mode
- New environment for Drift Zone maps in Circuit mode
- Little tweaks in physics model
- New steering wheels animation
- Tweaks for driving assists (in Normal and Hard driving mode)
- Better behaviour of automatic transmission 
- New prices for Bunia 30 & Bunia 35 & JDM1
- Some minor fixes and graphic optimization

Have fun and see you on the track!

notes.title: Drift Zone Available On Steam Today!
notes.content:
We are excited about today's launch of [b]Drift Zone[/b]!  We look forward to speak with the community and recieve feedback to constantly improve gameplay and add new content in future updates. Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy the game as much as we do. 

[u]One small suggestion for our new drifters[/u] - we reccomend you playing with a gamepad for maximum experience!

Awesome Industries
